records.name: Дейтерий
records.brief: Hydrogen isotope: greater mass; model valence 1.

records.name: Тритий
records.brief: Radioactive hydrogen isotope; shown here as an illustrative label.

records.name: Уран
records.brief: Actinide: U-238 by default; A− can display U-235 in this model.

records.name: Железо
records.brief: Transition metal: Fe(II) and Fe(III) are common; iron occurs in oxides and biomolecules.

records.name: Медь
records.brief: Transition metal: Cu(I) and Cu(II) are common. The model permits Cu-for-Fe substitution in illustrative biomolecular sketches; this does not establish a biological analogue.

records.name: Лютеций
records.brief: Lanthanide: Lu-177 appears in an illustrative DOTA-like radiopharmaceutical sketch.

records.name: Иттрий
records.brief: Transition metal: Y-90 is an illustrative beta-emitting radiometal in chelator examples.

records.name: Актиний
records.brief: Actinide: Ac-225 is shown only as a conceptual alpha-emitting label.

records.name: Радий
records.brief: Radioactive alkaline-earth element: Ra-223 is shown without practical nuclear parameters.

records.name: Самарий
records.brief: Lanthanide: Sm-153 is used here as an illustrative radiometal label.

records.name: Стронций
records.brief: Alkaline-earth metal: Sr-89 illustrates a Ca/Sr analogy in a bone-related example, without biological validation.

records.name: Йод
records.brief: Halogen: I-131 is represented in this model as a covalent radiolabel.

records.name: Астат
records.brief: Heavy halogen: At-211 is shown as an illustrative alpha-emitting label, without handling guidance.
